lineage: The project team's historical instrument account, with dated milestones.

passages.note: Official first-light exposures were taken on 12 September 2012. Commissioning occupied September and October 2012 and Science Verification began in October 2012, with further DES verification through February 2013. The camera also serves as a community facility instrument.
